issues.description: TUBB4 (cilia marker) and SAA (serum amyloid A) are not uniquely resolvable to single gene symbols in the main text (TUBB4A/TUBB4B; SAA1/SAA2/SAA4); candidates 9 and 10 are marked unresolved.
CD8 is used as a protein/cell-surface designation ('CD8+ T cells'), not as a specific gene-level marker; candidate 2 is excluded on this basis.
Neuroendocrine (NE) cells are listed among ASE cell types in Figure 1D, but no NE marker gene is named in the Markdown main text; possible NE marker genes may only be in Table E4 (not provided).
